text_en: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord :
text_cn: 这是上主传给耶肋米亚的话：

text_en: Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel: Write in a book all the words that I have spoken to you.
text_cn: 上主以色列的天主这样说：“凡我对你说的话，你都要写在一本书上，

text_en: For the days are surely coming, says the Lord , when I will restore the fortunes of my people, Israel and Judah, says the Lord , and I will bring them back to the land that I gave to their ancestors and they shall take possession of it.
text_cn: 因为，看，时日将到──上主的断语──我必转变我人民以色列和犹大的命运──上主说──使他们回去占领我赐给他们祖先的土地。”

text_en: These are the words that the Lord spoke concerning Israel and Judah:
text_cn: 以下是上主论及以色列和犹大说的话：

text_en: Thus says the Lord : We have heard a cry of panic, of terror, and no peace.
text_cn: 上主这样说：“人听到了恐怖的喊叫：只有恐慌，没有平安。

text_en: Ask now, and see, can a man bear a child? Why then do I see every man with his hands on his loins like a woman in labor? Why has every face turned pale?
text_cn: 你们且自问自究：是否男人要生产？为什么我竟见人人两手叉腰，像正在生产的妇女，个个面色显得苍白？

text_en: Alas! that day is so great there is none like it; it is a time of distress for Jacob; yet he shall be rescued from it.
text_cn: 噫！这一天，真伟大，无可比拟，虽为雅各伯是痛苦的时期，但他们将由此而得救。

text_en: On that day, says the Lord of hosts, I will break the yoke from off his neck, and I will burst his bonds, and strangers shall no more make a servant of him.
text_cn: 到了那一天──万军上主的断语──我要折断他们颈上所负的轭，粉碎他们的锁链，他们不再作外方人的奴隶，

text_en: But they shall serve the Lord their God and David their king, whom I will raise up for them.
text_cn: 只服事上主，他们的天主，和我给他们兴起的君王达味。

text_en: But as for you, have no fear, my servant Jacob, says the Lord , and do not be dismayed, O Israel; for I am going to save you from far away, and your offspring from the land of their captivity. Jacob shall return and have quiet and ease, and no one shall make him afraid.
text_cn: 为此，我的仆人雅各伯，你不用害怕──上主的断语──以色列，你不要惊慌；因为，看，我必从远方救出你来，从充军之地救回你的后裔；使雅各伯归来，居享安宁，无所恐惧，

text_en: For I am with you, says the Lord , to save you; I will make an end of all the nations among which I scattered you, but of you I will not make an end. I will chastise you in just measure, and I will by no means leave you unpunished.
text_cn: 因为有我与你同在──上主的断语──作你的救援。诚然，对我使你流徙所到的各民族，我要执行毁灭；但对你，我却不执行毁灭，只依正义惩罚你，不让你全然免罚。”

text_en: For thus says the Lord : Your hurt is incurable, your wound is grievous.
text_cn: 不错，上主这样说：“你的创伤不可治疗，你的伤口无法医治；

text_en: There is no one to uphold your cause, no medicine for your wound, no healing for you.
text_cn: 没有人愿意担任调理你的创伤，无药可使你的伤处收结。

text_en: All your lovers have forgotten you; they care nothing for you; for I have dealt you the blow of an enemy, the punishment of a merciless foe, because your guilt is great, because your sins are so numerous.
text_cn: 你所有的爱人都忘掉了你，不再追求你，因为我像打击敌人一样，以残酷的刑罚打击了你，因为你太不义，你的罪恶，增添不已。

text_en: Why do you cry out over your hurt? Your pain is incurable. Because your guilt is great, because your sins are so numerous, I have done these things to you.
text_cn: 为什么你还要为你的创伤悲号？你的创伤已不可治疗：因为你太不义，你的罪恶增添不已，我才这样对待了你。

text_en: Therefore all who devour you shall be devoured, and all your foes, every one of them, shall go into captivity; those who plunder you shall be plundered, and all who prey on you I will make a prey.
text_cn: 但是，凡吞灭你的，必被吞灭；凡与你为敌的，必被掳去充军；凡劫掠你的，必遭劫掠；凡抢夺你的，我必使他们受人抢夺。

text_en: For I will restore health to you, and your wounds I will heal, says the Lord , because they have called you an outcast: “It is Zion; no one cares for her! ”
text_cn: 实在，我要使你的伤处收结，疗愈你的创伤──上主的断语──因为他们称你为弃妇，无人过问的熙雍。”

text_en: Thus says the Lord : I am going to restore the fortunes of the tents of Jacob, and have compassion on his dwellings; the city shall be rebuilt upon its mound, and the citadel set on its rightful site.
text_cn: 上主这样说：“看，我要转变雅各伯帐幕命运，怜悯他的家室，好使城市仍建在自己的山上，宫殿依然耸立在自己的原处，

text_en: Out of them shall come thanksgiving, and the sound of merrymakers. I will make them many, and they shall not be few; I will make them honored, and they shall not be disdained.
text_cn: 从那里发出颂谢的歌声，欢乐的呼声。我必使他们繁昌，人数不再减少；我要显耀他们，使他们不再受人轻视。

text_en: Their children shall be as of old, their congregation shall be established before me; and I will punish all who oppress them.
text_cn: 他们的子孙必要像昔日一样，在我面前重新建立自己的集会；凡压迫他们的，我必予以惩罚。

text_en: Their prince shall be one of their own, their ruler shall come from their midst; I will bring him near, and he shall approach me, for who would otherwise dare to approach me? says the Lord .
text_cn: 他们的元首，将是他们中的一个；他们的统帅，将出自他们之中；我要使他前来接近我，他必与我接近，因为谁敢冒性命的危险来与我接近──上主的断语──

text_en: And you shall be my people, and I will be your God.
text_cn: 这样，你们必作我的人民，我必作你们的天主。”

text_en: Look, the storm of the Lord ! Wrath has gone forth, a whirling tempest; it will burst upon the head of the wicked.
text_cn: 看上主的愤怒，如暴风怒号，如横扫的暴风，在恶人的头上旋转。

text_en: The fierce anger of the Lord will not turn back until he has executed and accomplished the intents of his mind. In the latter days you will understand this.
text_cn: 上主的烈怒必不止息，直到他执行完成了他心里的计划；在末日你们必会明了。
